scope: Proposition 4.5 (Consequences of the increment bound) of the manuscript “The low-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick free-energy limiting law” (preprints/The-low-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-free-energy-limiting-law-September-24-2026/The-low-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-free-energy-limiting-law-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 217 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4acb0e456988f38e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 29. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume Proposition 4.1. For every fixed integer k ≥ 1, the moments EY k n converge at a positive power rate. Their limiting second moment is finite and strictly positive, and the centered variables Yn have uniformly bounded exponential moments on some constant neighborhood of the origin. They converge weakly to a moment-determinate law. Removing the completion and standardizing by the exact finite-size variance gives the convergence asserted in Theorem 1.1.
